verdict.rationale: Parahelp documents first-party automations: Internal Agent tasks that run on a schedule or a trigger, managed from an Automations page with templates. They can be set to auto-approve so they act without waiting for a human, which delivers background autonomous execution. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that automations run reliably unattended, and detail on monitoring or run history for background runs (actions default to manual approval unless auto-approve is enabled).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: An automation is an Internal Agent task that runs on a schedule, like every weekday at 9am, or a trigger, like a GitHub PR merging
Set up automations on the "Automations" page. It shows all existing automations and includes templates for common setups.
Enable auto-approve for a task or automation, and the Internal Agent can perform any action through the connection without asking for approval.
Set up automations that watch your tools and your support queue and surface gaps on their own.
